verdict.rationale: Polar documents balance visibility and a manual withdrawal/payout mechanism gated by a minimum threshold, plus refunds and order/charge tracking, giving finance-ops some reconciliation ability. However, there's no evidence of a configurable payout schedule (e.g., automatic weekly/monthly payout cadence) or a consolidated payout report itemizing which specific charges, fees, and refunds roll up into a given payout. missing for 10: documented payout scheduling/cadence controls, a per-payout itemized breakdown of constituent charges/fees/refunds, and any reconciliation report or export tying payouts to transactions.
